policy: RESIDENTIAL DWELLING INSURANCE / Policy wording "WD-2026" - Water Escape, External Surfaces and Site Charges
description: Buildings frost claim after a prolonged deep freeze. Two separate things happened. Inside, a water fitting failed in the cold and had to be repaired, with a thermal imaging camera used to find where the escape was before opening up. Outside, and unrelated to the internal fitting, the exterior render simply could not take the freeze-thaw cycling. The plaster cracked, blew and fell off the facade under the cold acting on it from the outside. No internal water reached that render; it was the outdoor temperature working on the wall surface. For the file: the owner is not putting the plain render back as it was. The facade is being redone in a premium insulated render system, a clear upgrade on the old plain plaster, and the crew are taking the new finish across elevations that had not lost any render.

lines.7: Facade frost damage from outdoor freeze-thaw 1 pcs
